pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection for GCaMP8s expression and VGLUT1 conditional knockout in CA3

parameters.ca3_pyramidal_imaging_virus: Cre-dependent rAAV9-Syn-FLEX-jGCaMP8s-WPRE-SV40 (Addgene #162377, titer 2.3x10^13 vg/mL) in Grik4-cre mice
parameters.vglut1_cko_viruses: rAAV1-hSyn-Cre (Addgene #105553), rAAV1-hSyn-DIO-mCherry (Addgene #50459), rAAV9-Syn-jGCaMP8s-WPRE-SV40 (Addgene #162374) in Slc17a7flox/flox mice
parameters.coordinates: proximal and distal CA3 each targeted with two x-y coordinates and two DV injection sites: AP -1.46/ML -1.75/DV -2.1,-1.9 and AP -1.46/ML -1.3/DV -2.3,-2.1 relative to bregma, 60 nL per DV site
parameters.delivery: sterile glass capillary on a Nanoject syringe (Drummond Scientific), pipette held 5-10 min post-injection before retraction

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice expressing GCaMP8s in proximal/distal CA3 pyramidal neurons (or VGLUT1 cKO)
pipeline_steps.hardware: Nanoject syringe (Drummond Scientific); stereotaxic instrument (Kopf Instruments)

pipeline_steps.technique: Hippocampal imaging window and headpost implantation

parameters.craniotomy: 3-mm craniotomy over right anterior hippocampus, centered between the injection coordinates
parameters.window: 3-mm glass-bottomed stainless-steel cannula (1.5 mm height) implanted after aspirating overlying cortex, CA1 kept intact
parameters.headpost: titanium headpost attached with dental cement
parameters.recovery: 14-day recovery before behavioral training began; 3 days of post-operative monitoring immediately after surgery

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic hippocampal imaging window and headpost

pipeline_steps.technique: Water-restricted virtual-reality training for water reward

parameters.environment: 2-meter-long linear VR corridor, consistent across training and recording, with a 2-s blank-screen inter-trial interval and teleport to the next lap
parameters.training: 10-14 days; habituation phase used non-operant water delivery on reward-zone entry plus continued licking within a 30 cm area; training phase required an operant correct lick within the reward zone to trigger reward
parameters.criterion: mice trained to run at least 30 laps in the environment

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice trained to run and lick for reward in a fixed VR corridor

pipeline_steps.technique: Context-switching behavioral paradigm with distinct familiar and novel visual cues

parameters.session_structure: 4 blocks per session: 15 laps Familiar, 15 laps Novel, 15 laps Familiar, 15 laps Novel, on a 200 cm track
parameters.reward_position: fixed at 150 cm in both contexts
parameters.cue_design: distinct visual cue sets used for the novel context between proximal- and distal-CA3 imaging cohorts; familiar context held constant within each cohort

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: imaging and behavioral data across familiar/novel context blocks

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging transcardial perfusion, sectioning, and PCP4/VGLUT1 immunostaining

parameters.perfusion: 40 mL ice-cold PBS followed by 40 mL ice-cold 4% PFA, brain post-fixed overnight at 4°C
parameters.sectioning: 100 µm coronal hippocampal sections on a vibratome (Leica VT1200-S)
parameters.blocking: 5% normal donkey serum, 0.3% PBST, 2 hours at room temperature
parameters.pcp4_stain: rabbit anti-PCP4 (1:500, Sigma HPA005792) overnight at 4°C, then Alexa 647-conjugated donkey anti-rabbit secondary (1:800) for 2 hours
parameters.vglut1_stain: Cy5-conjugated rabbit anti-VGLUT1 (1:500, Synaptic Systems 135303C5) overnight at 4°C
parameters.imaging: Nikon Ti-E A1R confocal microscope, 10x/0.45NA or 20x/0.75NA objectives, 3 µm z-stacks processed in NIS Elements or Fiji

pipeline_steps.hardware: Leica VT1200-S vibratome; Nikon Ti-E A1R confocal microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon Ca2+ imaging acquisition across CA3 subregions

parameters.scanner: 8 kHz resonant scanner (Bruker), 25x/1.0 NA objective (Olympus XLPLN25XWMP2)
parameters.laser: 920 nm femtosecond-pulsed laser (Chameleon Ultra II, Coherent), Pockels-cell power regulation
parameters.detection: emission filter (HQ525/70m-2p) to a GaAsP PMT (Hamamatsu 7422P-40), custom dual-stage preamp (Bruker)
parameters.fov_targeting: distal CA3 FOV identified first by anatomical landmarks; proximal CA3 FOV defined by a mediolateral shift of at least 400-500 µm and a dorsoventral shift of at least 200-300 µm from the distal FOV

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon Ca2+ fluorescence video from proximal and distal CA3
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8-kHz resonant scanner; Olympus 25x/1.0NA objective; Coherent Chameleon Ultra II laser; Hamamatsu GaAsP PMT 7422P-40

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction, ROI drawing, and cross-day ROI registration

parameters.roi_drawing: manual hand-drawn ROIs over each cell's inspected time-average frame using an in-lab data visualization server program
parameters.cross_day_tracking: ROI masks from day n aligned to day m, each neuron assigned a unique longitudinal ID (days 1, 3, 5, 7)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected video with longitudinally tracked somatic ROIs

pipeline_steps.technique: Fluorescence extraction and ΔF/F calculation with neuropil correction

parameters.neuropil_correction: six surrounding patches at 50% of the original ROI size
parameters.baseline: first percentile within a rolling 30-s window
parameters.smoothing: exponential filter applied to the ΔF/F trace
parameters.event_detection: statistically significant transients detected as previously described, used for place-field calculations

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: ΔF/F traces and significant transient events per cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning curve calculation and place-field detection via shuffled null distribution

parameters.binning: 100 spatial bins (2 cm) over the 2-m track, running-filtered (>3 cm/s), excluding the teleportation interval
parameters.null_construction: 1,000 circular shuffles of per-lap activity; 95th percentile of baseline tuning values per bin as the significance threshold (p<0.05)
parameters.field_criteria: 3-24 consecutive significant bins (6-50 cm), with activity in at least 20% of laps
parameters.cell_metrics: place-cell sensitivity (fraction of laps with an active event in the field) and specificity (fraction of a lap's events within the field), averaged across laps/fields per ROI; spatial information calculated as previously described

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: spatial tuning curves, detected place fields, sensitivity/specificity/spatial-information metrics

parameters.metric: Pearson correlation between a place cell's tuning curves across all pairs of sessions on different days
parameters.inclusion: cells with place fields on both compared days

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-cell spatial tuning curves across sessions

pipeline_steps.technique: Population vector correlation across days and contexts

parameters.metric: Pearson correlation between population vectors of corresponding spatial bins across session pairs, averaged across bins, reported as a function of day interval
parameters.context_comparisons: also applied within/across contexts (F1 vs F2, N1 vs N2, F vs N)
parameters.inclusion: cells classified as place cells on both compared sessions, or in at least one of two blocks for context comparisons

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: population vectors of spatial tuning across sessions

parameters.formula: DI = (μ1 - μ2) / sqrt((σ1² + σ2²)/2), where μ and σ are the mean and SD of calcium response amplitude across laps in each context
parameters.significance: 1,000 lap-permuted surrogate datasets; observed DI considered significant if beyond the top/bottom 2.5% of the surrogate distribution

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-lap calcium response amplitudes by context
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell discrimination index and context-selectivity classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Population decoding of context via SVM and cross-condition generalization performance

parameters.decoder: linear SVM classifying neural population activity into familiar vs. novel context, leave-one-trial-out cross-validation per imaging session
parameters.subregion_comparison: proximal CA3 cells subsampled to match average distal CA3 ROI count before comparing decoding accuracy
parameters.ccgp_context: linear SVM trained on one spatial bin (F-P1 vs N-P1) and tested on a non-overlapping bin (F-P2 vs N-P2) to assess context generalization across positions
parameters.ccgp_position: decoder trained to discriminate two spatial positions in one context and tested in the other, and vice versa
parameters.significance: 1,000 shuffles of context labels, empirical accuracy compared to the resulting null distribution

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: neural population activity patterns by lap/context

pipeline_steps.technique: Deep-superficial cell classification via PCA of ROI centroid position

parameters.method: PCA on x/y centroid coordinates of distal CA3 ROIs; PC1 defines a 'middle line'; signed, session-normalized distance from this line computed per ROI
parameters.classification: top 10% of normalized signed distances classified 'superficial', bottom 10% classified 'deep'
parameters.comparison: discrimination index compared between superficial and deep groups

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: superficial/deep cell classification and group DI comparison

pipeline_steps.technique: Neural manifold dimensionality analysis via PCA

parameters.input: neuron-by-time activity matrix, mean-centered across time, proximal CA3 subsampled to match distal CA3 ROI counts
parameters.decomposition: eigen-decomposition of the neuron-neuron covariance matrix; PCA performed on time samples concatenated across trials without prior trial-averaging
parameters.metrics: k90 (minimum PCs explaining at least 90% cumulative variance), participation ratio, and variance explained by the first 5 PCs (EV5)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: manifold dimensionality metrics (k90, participation ratio, EV5)

pipeline_steps.technique: Intrinsic dimensionality estimation via TwoNN and Levina-Bickel MLE

parameters.twonn: Two-Nearest-Neighbors method: linear regression of log(1-F(µ)) on log(µ) for the nearest/second-nearest-neighbor distance ratio µ, after trimming the extreme 5% tails; fit quality assessed via R2
parameters.levina_bickel: maximum likelihood local dimension estimate averaged across neighborhood sizes k = 5, 10, 15, 20, with stability checked across k = 2-20
parameters.diagnostics: log-scale eigenvalue spectra inspection and a cross-method Spearman correlation matrix across k90, participation ratio, TwoNN, LB-MLE, and EV5; proximal vs. distal CA3 compared via unpaired two-tailed t-tests and Mann-Whitney U tests per measure

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: intrinsic dimensionality estimates and cross-method agreement diagnostics

parameters.tests: two-sided unpaired t-test, Mann-Whitney U test, Kruskal-Wallis test with post hoc Dunn's multiple comparison tests
parameters.reporting: boxplots show 25th/50th/75th percentiles with whiskers to 1.5x interquartile range; data expressed as mean ± SEM
parameters.software: custom Python (2.7.15 and 3.8.11) analysis and visualization code
